newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VENDEX 96/97 H1 NET PROFIT NLG 151 MLN.
newsitem.headline: VENDEX 96/97 H1 NET PROFIT NLG 151 MLN.

text.p: Six months to end July 1996
(in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
Net per shr (guilders) 1.78 vs 1.42
Net profit 151 vs 125
Turnover (billions) 5.70 vs 5.35
Operating profit 153 vs 129
Interim dividend (guilders) 0.55 vs 0.50
Interest charges 30 vs 36
Tax 14 vs 8
Changes in value of fixed
assests and securities gain 41 vs 37 gain
NOTES - Retail and business services group Vendex
International said first-half operating profit included 47
million guilders from the sale and redevelopment of property
versus 42 million in the first half of 1995/96.
Analysts had expected Vendex to report a net profit
excluding changes in the value of fixed assets and securities of
98 to 125 million guilders, with the consensus at 110 million.
Vendex International's financial year begins on February 1
and ends on January 31 of the following calendar year.
